workerResult.summary: Midnight Trolley Ledger — click-only night-trolley fare ledger. Punch coin-denomination tickets onto a paper tape (click row to void/un-void), switch 4 night routes on a side rail with live per-route stats, cycle ledger totals (shift/by-route/voided), settle shifts into persisted history. localStorage persistence with validated load, two-click tape clear, 1000-entry cap. Extreme-minimal: ink/paper/lamp/oxide/moss palette, Instrument Serif + Spline Sans Mono, asymmetric rail/tape/fare-box layout. Build exits 0, preview serves 200, relative asset paths.
